title: Open Source
description: The code is available for anyone to see.

title: Proxy Contract
description: A contract that acts on behalf of another, adding features without changing the original.

title: Mintable
description: New tokens can be created after the initial creation.

title: Owner Address
description: The digital wallet address of the current token owner.

title: Retrieve Ownership
description: Ability to take back control of the token.

title: Balance Mod
description: Changes to the number of tokens in someone's wallet.

title: Hidden Owner
description: The owner's identity is not publicly disclosed.

title: Self Destruct
description: Token can be programmed to disappear.

title: External Call Risk
description: Risk from the token interacting with outside contracts.

title: Buy Tax
description: Extra fees on transactions.

title: Sell Tax
description: Extra fees on transactions.

title: Buy Available
description: Restrictions on buying or selling the token.

title: Cannot Sell All
description: Restrictions on buying or selling the token.

title: Slippage Mod
description: Slippage in trading refers to the difference between the expected price of a trade and the price at which it is actually executed.

title: Honeypot
description: A trap making it impossible to sell the token later.

title: Transfer Pausable
description: Ability to stop transactions temporarily.

title: Blacklisted
description: Lists controlling who can use or hold the token.

title: Whitelisted
description: Lists controlling who can use or hold the token.

title: In Dex
description: Available on decentralized exchanges.

title: Anti-Whale
description: Measures against large market-manipulating transactions.

title: Anti-Whale Mod
description: Ability to modify the Anti-Whale measures.

title: Trading Cooldown
description: Waiting period between trades.

title: Token Name
description: Name of the token.

title: Token Symbol
description: Symbol representing the token.

title: Holders
description: Number of token holders.

title: Total Supply
description: Total number of tokens in circulation.

title: Owner Balance
description: Balance of tokens owned by the owner.

title: Owner Percent
description: Percentage of total token supply owned by the owner.

title: Creator Address
description: Address of the token's creator.

title: Creator Balance
description: Balance of tokens owned by the creator.

title: Creator Percent
description: Percentage of total token supply owned by the creator.

title: LP Holders
description: Number of liquidity pool (LP) token holders.

title: LP Total Supply
description: Total number of liquidity pool (LP) tokens in circulation.
